description: List the model ids available on apimodels.app (chat, image, video, audio). Use the returned ids with the other tools. Caveat: a handful of entries are internal names that the generation endpoints reject (e.g. seedance-2-fast, seedance-2, motion-control) — the public alias is the dotted form, e.g. seedance-2.0-fast. If an id comes back "Invalid model", try the dotted variant before giving up.
name: list_models
